notes: Real footage (user-provided), not synthetic - an 18s clip from a fixed elevated CCTV camera over a 6-lane one-way Chinese urban arterial (Chinese date overlay, '公交专用' bus-lane markings). Vehicle mix is cars/a truck/a bus/one scooter - NOT Karachi's motorcycle-dominant traffic KT-Radar is tuned for. site_config now sets class_source: coco_subset with a matching vehicle_classes list (car/bus/truck/motorcycle/pedestrian/bicycle), so this is a normal coco_subset site, not a special case - but a coco_subset site still only sees that subset, nothing like a rickshaw or qingqi, so still don't expect Karachi-taxonomy results here. manual_line_counts and known_speed_checks are deliberately left empty: nobody has actually watched this clip and counted vehicles by eye, or independently verified a vehicle's speed, and the harness's own rule is not to guess ground truth - see tests/eval/README.md. To make this clip usable for real evaluation: (1) watch it and fill in manual_line_counts for the 'arterial_mid' line (a car/truck/bus/motorcycle/pedestrian tally is enough to start), and (2) site_config's calibration is an UNVERIFIED VISUAL ESTIMATE (see its own header comment) - replace it with a real measurement before trusting any speed_kmh this clip produces.
